items.text: Benzene is a colourless liquid with a boiling temperature of 80°C, and it is insoluble in water It is present in crude oil and thefuelsobtainedfromit,so thepetroltankofa carcontains some benzene. The one place you will not find it is in a school or college laboratory,because of its toxicnature;in particular,it is a carcinogen(i.e.it can cause cancer).It was first isolated by the English chemist Michael Faraday in 1825.Within a few years,the compound became known as benzene and its molecularformula wasestablished.
